name: IPSTesting
title: IPS: TestPlans and Gherkin for the IPS actors
description: A demonstration IG that declares, as TestPlan resources and Gherkin feature files, the conformance tests for the three actors of the HL7 International Patient Summary (IPS) 2.0.1: Creator, Consumer and Server. The tests are derived mechanically from the obligations the IPS profiles state, and every obligation is traceable to a test case that names its element.
disclaimer: This is not an approved HL7 test specification.

actors.title: IPS Creator
actors.scopeDescription: The IPS Creator actor — a system which produces, assembles or creates an IPS document — is the system under test.
actors.summary: the document the Creator produces for the reference patient carries every element it is obliged to populate

actors.title: IPS Consumer
actors.scopeDescription: The IPS Consumer actor — a system that receives an IPS document and uses its content — is the system under test.
actors.summary: the Consumer accepts the reference document without error and displays what it should

actors.title: IPS Server
actors.scopeDescription: The IPS Server actor — a FHIR server acting as an IPS Creator through the $summary operation — is the system under test.
actors.summary: the $summary operation returns a conformant IPS document; the Creator plan then applies to it
